optionalManifestBundles.label: Background video playback
optionalManifestBundles.warning: Requesting FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK triggers Play Console policy review for a foreground service, Google asks for a justification before you can publish.
optionalManifestBundles.nextSteps: Set `staysActiveInBackground` and `showNowPlayingNotification` on the player. On iOS add `audio` to UIBackgroundModes in Info.plist yourself.
